name: Filesystem Security and Compliance Scan (compliance rendition)
description: Run a Trivy scan on the local file system to detect vulnerabilities, secrets, and misconfigurations. Reported for regulatory traceability.

reporting.expectedOutput: Obligations this run evidenced, obligations it did not, the tool version and severity filter applied, and every stated limit on scope

notes: Sibling of sample_intent_fs_scan_management.json with identical target, parameters and criteria. Four criteria exercise all three coverage statuses: nis2 and iso27001 resolve to assessed (the trivy-filesystem skill carries evidence bearing on 2 and 3 of their requirements respectively); linddun resolves to declaredNotAssessed (no requirement recorded under it is evaluable by a filesystem scanner); internal_supplychain_policy:v1 resolves to unrecognised (not in the ontology). regulatoryCoverage.complete is therefore false, with byStatus {assessed: 2, declaredNotAssessed: 1, unrecognised: 1}. Note that 'assessed' means evidence bears on the listed requirements, not that the regulation is met.
